hooks.command:
cat >/dev/null 2>&1
[ -n "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ] && exit 0
git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
if ! GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch --quiet 2>/dev/null; then printf '{"systemMessage":"[git] fetch failed (offline or no creds) - repo status not checked"}\n'; exit 0; fi
branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)
msg="[git] "
if git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/remotes/origin/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then if git rev-parse --verify --quiet refs/heads/main >/dev/null 2>&1; then bm=$(git rev-list --count main..origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "${bm:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then msg="${msg}main is ${bm} commit(s) behind origin/main - run: git checkout main && git pull. "; else msg="${msg}main is up to date. "; fi; else msg="${msg}no local main branch - freshness check skipped. "; fi; fi
if [ "$branch" != "main" ] && [ "$branch" != "HEAD" ]; then if up=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name '@{u}' 2>/dev/null); then bb=$(git rev-list --count "HEAD..$up" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "${bb:-0}" -gt 0 ] && msg="${msg}Your branch '${branch}' is ${bb} behind ${up}. "; fi; fi
msg=$(printf '%s' "$msg" | tr -d '"\\')
printf '{"systemMessage":"%s"}\n' "$msg"
